note: Small RV park north of Bedford near Lake of Three Fires State Park, in three areas: The Hollow under shade trees, The Covey in an open meadow, The Water's Edge overlooking a pond with a fountain. Entered through the Deer Ridge at Lexington wedding venue's parking lot. --Claude
summary: Operator's page confirms 19 sites, 50-amp, full hookups on 1-6, $30-50; added pull-through, 120-day window, reservations required, online Mar-Oct, phone in winter, open all year weather permitting. Passes gates.
flags: PRIVATE GATE FACTS: cheapest real night $30 (water/electric, sites 7-14), operator's own page; page undated but it carries the current winter-booking notice. Firefly kiosk loads, but online booking is shut for winter so I couldn't quote a night. Gateway: none within 40 km (Kansas City 180 km); not needed at $30. Google Maps 4.9 / 20 reviews, open, phone 712-542-9272, site www.qhrvpark.com. RV Life stored 5*/$$, which I did not re-read. Google is under 25 reviews, so no rating rule applies from what I read. Not in the cached Good Sam directory. Not read: Campendium, The Dyrt, Campspot.

LONG-STAY TESTS: no monthly or seasonal rates, no residents, no homes for sale anywhere on the site or policies PDF; nightly prices posted and online booking. All five pass; this reads as a nightly park.

WATERFRONT LEAD (not waterfront -> pond for 3 of 19 sites; I changed nothing): operator's sites 17-19 are 'on a stained concrete pad overlooking the pond and fountain', with 'front-row views of the pond'. Imagery shows pale pads at the pond's NW corner about 20 m of open grass from the water, no road visible between (imagery may predate the landscaping; a turnaround lies behind the pads, on the far side from the water). Pond scaled from imagery at about 0.7 ha / 1.7 acres, under the 5-acre line. A 'nearby mowed green space' and a fishing spot are near those sites; I can't say from imagery whether they lie between pads and water. These sites cost $50, still within the gate.

FACILITIES: neither the site nor the policies PDF mentions showers, restrooms or a dump station. Sites 7-19 have no sewer ('Full Hookup coming soon' at Water's Edge), so a camper there may have no dump on site. Left unset; worth asking Angela at 712-542-9272.
PIN: stored pin is within about 50 m of the centre of the three areas; good. Google's point (40.71933,-94.67827) is on the wedding venue's building.
